summary: Fiverr International Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release of its Q2 2026 earnings results. The release discusses a strategic shift toward higher-value work, financial highlights (revenue $97.8M, down 10% YoY), and revised 2026 guidance due to AI-related headwinds. No special-situation transaction (acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, etc.) is announced. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
